subject.title: [Bug] LINE channel webhook returns 404 after v2026.5.28 update

question: Does the reporter's failing setup match the merged LINE account-resolution fix, the open gateway route-lifecycle issue, or a distinct LINE webhook route bug?
rationale: The merged resolver fix covers one plausible 404 path, but the provider-start detail points at a different route attachment layer and the issue lacks the config needed to classify the failure safely.

options.title: Ask For Config And Current-Main Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a redacted `channels.line` config plus a retry on current main or the next release before closing or duplicating it.

options.title: Close As LINE Resolver Fixed
options.body: Close as implemented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81471 only if maintainers accept that the report used `accounts.default` or named-account config despite the provider-start wording.

options.title: Fold Into Gateway Route Lifecycle
options.body: Close as a duplicate of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94572 only if maintainers confirm the installed LINE plugin is hitting the same route registry attachment gap.

recommendation.title: Ask For Config And Current-Main Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and request a redacted `channels.line` config plus a retry on current main or the next release before closing or duplicating it.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses the plugin route-registry invariant and LINE resolver overlap, and history points to steipete on the adjacent route-registry behavior.
